summary: Governed internal agent runtime (A00 route / A10 normalize / A20 draft) over the Postgres run ledger and the internal AI gateway. Private network only; feature-flagged inactive until the bounded canary.

target.note: server and destination are null on purpose, matching deploy/ai-gateway.json: the reconciler resolves them from the instance and aborts when the match is not unique, rather than guessing. This spec has not yet been reconciled against a live Coolify application -- it is written ahead of the first `coolify-deploy.yml -f operation=deploy -f service=agent-runtime` run, which will create the application from this declaration.

source.note: Same private-repo App as deploy/ai-gateway.json; the built-in 'Public GitHub' source cannot read this private repository.

network.note: public_fqdn is null and must stay null: this service is reachable only from the private Docker network, exactly like ai-gateway. peer_probe_application names ai-gateway (not ops-runner) because the one live outbound call this service makes in the canary is to ai-gateway, so that is the reachability check that actually matters for this service.

health_check.note: Same rationale and same failure mode already documented and fixed in deploy/ai-gateway.json's note: this image (python:3.11-slim, minimal system deps) carries neither curl nor wget, so Coolify's generated coolify_http probe would fail every attempt. container_gate is 'image' -- the image's own HEALTHCHECK instruction (services/adapteng-agent-runtime/Dockerfile) is the real gate, requires health_check.enabled=false, and its four numbers must stay equal to the ones declared here since Coolify reads them back out of the image and overwrites its own stored values. Unlike ai-gateway's history, this service has never been deployed, so there is no incident to cite -- the Dockerfile's HEALTHCHECK was written with these exact four numbers from the start, precisely to avoid repeating that incident.
health_check.container_gate_note: Probes /ready, not /health, for the same reason as ai-gateway: /health answers without touching the database, so gating promotion on it would prove only that a process is listening. /ready opens a database connection to the run ledger (see app/config.py::verify_database_reachable), so a container that cannot reach Postgres is never promoted.

delivery.note: Deployment is driven only by the deploy operation of .github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml (workflow_dispatch only), so a push to the platform repository never releases by itself. force_https is off because there is no public route to redirect.

settings_not_reported_by_api.note: Same Coolify-version limitation already documented in deploy/ai-gateway.json's settings_not_reported_by_api: the four delivery flags are not reported back by this Coolify instance's API, so the driver reports them here for the owner to confirm in the UI rather than writing a value it cannot verify by read-back.

is_auto_deploy_enabled.reason: Not reported and not accepted by the creation endpoint on this version (same as ai-gateway).
is_auto_deploy_enabled.compensating_control: Releases are driven only by the deploy operation of .github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml, which is workflow_dispatch only.

is_preview_deployments_enabled.reason: Not accepted by the creation endpoint on this version (same as ai-gateway).
is_preview_deployments_enabled.compensating_control: public_fqdn is null and reconcile fails if an FQDN appears, so a preview has no route to publish on.

is_force_https_enabled.reason: Not reported on this version (same as ai-gateway).
is_force_https_enabled.compensating_control: There is no public route to redirect.

connect_to_docker_network.reason: Not reported on this version (same as ai-gateway).
connect_to_docker_network.compensating_control: network.network_aliases declares the alias this service needs; the same coolify-deploy.yml service-resolve operation used to verify ai-gateway's attachment can be run against this application before it is trusted for the canary.

configuration.note: The service image ends with ENV GOVERNED_AGENT_RUNTIME_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1, and app/config.py falls back to the same loopback address. A process bound to loopback answers only callers inside its own container, so the container-network health probe and the internal n8n caller would be refused. Binding all interfaces is what makes the container reachable on the private network; nothing is published to the internet.

Declared so the listening port, the internal_port above and the health-check port have exactly one source of truth in this file. 8082, not ai-gateway's 8081, so both services can run on hosts that share a network namespace.

Resolves via the private Docker network using ai-gateway's own declared network_aliases entry (deploy/ai-gateway.json), not a public URL. Depends on ai-gateway's alias actually resolving on this network -- verified once, for ai-gateway itself, by run 31590576870 (cited in deploy/ai-gateway.json); worth re-confirming with a service-resolve run once this application exists, since that history describes ai-gateway's own onboarding, not this one.
Passed as the gateway request's caller field (services/ai-gateway/app/models.py::GatewayRequest.caller), which the gateway's _CALLER_RE requires to be a bounded lowercase identifier.

Recorded into agent_run.model_provider on every ledger row. Descriptive only -- the actual provider routing is fixed inside ai-gateway itself (ADR-0010's canonical EU Vertex binding); this value never selects a provider.

Recorded into agent_run.model_version on every ledger row. Must track deploy/ai-gateway.json's AI_GATEWAY_MODEL value; the two are declared independently rather than templated from one source because they answer different questions (this repo's spec format has no cross-file reference mechanism), so a drift between them is a real thing to check for, not a formality.

Fails closed: app/config.py treats anything other than the exact lowercase string 'true' as inactive. POST /v1/run returns 503 {"error":"inactive"} while this is false. Flipped to 'true' only for the bounded Phase 7 canary window, then reconciled back to 'false'.

externally_provided_configuration.reason: Connection string for the same adapteng_ops run ledger ai-gateway and adapteng-run-ledger already write to, carrying a database password. Generated on the production host and posted to Coolify from there, so the password never reaches a runner, a log or this repository -- same handling as AI_GATEWAY_DATABASE_URL in deploy/ai-gateway.json.
One of ai-gateway's AI_GATEWAY_BEARER_TOKENS, dedicated to this caller. Caller authentication material; never written to this repository.

Inbound caller authentication material for POST /v1/run (the internal n8n orchestration is the only intended caller). Never written to this repository; supplied to a reconcile run by reference and held in the Coolify environment store, same pattern as AI_GATEWAY_BEARER_TOKENS.
